summary: Premier healer: dispels and Power Word: Shield make the priest the backbone of a Warsong Gulch premade. Intellect fuels the mana pool for a long flag game while stamina keeps the healer alive under focus.
factionNotes: Racials swing priest value at 19. Undead priests (Horde) get Will of the Forsaken, a strong on-demand break against fear, charm, and sleep (available from level 1). Dwarf priests (Alliance) do NOT yet have Fear Ward in this bracket — it is trained at level 20 (Fear Ward, spell 6346, requires level 20), so it is unavailable to a level-19 twink. Confirmed via Wowhead Classic.
